scope: Three-stage pi_sync and one logical SQLite library replicated over existing SSH

authorization.user_selected: Two SQLite replicas; indexed Life/Study note text, WUCAI highlights/annotations, already-collected Xiaohongshu text and provenance
authorization.scope_pinned: Current source root identities and three configured reading accounts
authorization.original_note_writes: Still require exact diary preview and user confirmation

implementation.authority: Mac owns notes/reading, VPS owns life; each owns independent annotations
implementation.merge: Origin revisions, idempotent current snapshots, tombstones and expected-version annotation updates
implementation.transport: Fixed SSH JSON exchange, <=200 records and about 1MB/page, default <=50 pages/run
implementation.source_refresh: Incremental existing file index; recent seven-day WUCAI <=2 pages; per-account currently visible Xiaohongshu favorites
implementation.safety: No arbitrary path/SQL/command in the fixed exchange, no original source writeback, no whole-library model preload
implementation.rollback: Existing VPS release rollback, first-run local index/reading-store backup, keep replicas and cursors

synthetic.tty_three_phases: Passed with synthetic stores; Enter skips diary and still refreshes/synchronizes; original note unchanged
cases: Lost SSH receipt after remote commit resumes without duplicate rows
Bounded large pages continue, unchanged runs transfer zero records
Delete plus old-page replay does not resurrect source text
Source withdrawal hides and tombstones dependent supplements
CAS rejects stale supplement changes and origin spoofing
Credential exclusion, path sanitization, URL token removal, account separation
Disabled accounts and explicit exclusions withdraw shared text
Offline roots retain existing data and are reported unavailable
Changed roots do not expand the approved shared scope
Unchanged notes are not reread or retransmitted
Noninteractive invocations never fetch or consume approvals
Only bound owner can search/read/save supplements

pending_acceptance: Owner's real chat choosing and using the shared knowledge tool
Owner's actual Obsidian diary write confirmation
